cues.text: Cover, frame one: $400? / THE TRAILER'S FULL. / SHE WON'T PAY IT. on a cover board over the driveway, EXAMPLE beside the $400. At 0.9 s a plain cut to the driveway (the cover's two lines stay up on a banner until "four"): a house, a trailer heaped with junk (a couch, a mattress, boxes, a fridge), the homeowner (k.client, cross, arms folded) on the drive. On "four" a plain cut in to her, closer: her bubble: $400? TOO MUCH. with an EXAMPLE tag beside it.
The same driveway, closer: the full trailer, the homeowner (argue). On "give" her bubble: I'LL GIVE YOU $200. with an EXAMPLE tag. On "dump" a slam over the trailer: DUMP IT BACK?
A plain cut to the same drive before the job: the pile still on the drive, nothing loaded yet, the homeowner calm. On "say" a slam over the pile: SAY THE PRICE, then AT THE PILE.

The send card on a plain cut, built line by line as each line is spoken: FOR YOUR DRIVER (the band) / BEFORE YOU LIFT (the title) from the cut; POINT AT THE PILE on "point"; "THIS LOAD IS [YOUR PRICE]. on "This"; GOOD TO START?" on "Good"; WAIT FOR HER YES on "wait". Full, it holds still about 3 s (through "A yes before the work"); only the stripes behind it drift. No EXAMPLE tag on the card (no made-up number on it).
On "is" a plain cut to two rows: top, teal: UP FRONT / A YES = A DEAL; bottom, red, on "price": AFTER THE WORK, then A PRICE = A FIGHT. The bottom row shakes once on "fight".

A newsprint clipping (THE ACHR NEWS masthead): "70% of homeowners surveyed said they were more likely to call an HVAC company/contractor who is transparent on pricing." with its tag: The ACHR News with myCLEARopinion, Dec 23, 2024. Read Nov 9, 2026. On "Seventy" a plain cut to the slot machine: the reels stop on 7, 0, % (data.js) with the label MORE LIKELY TO CALL.

The driveway again, before the job: the pile on the drive, nothing loaded yet, the homeowner calm. The stamp on "does": WHERE DOES YOUR PRICE GO? Then two cards: ON THE PILE on "pile", ON THE TRAILER on "trailer". Holds to the end card.
